name: Chacha Food Company, Limited
summary: Chacha Food Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells roasted nuts and seeds as snack food in China and internationally. The company offers sunflower seeds; nuts; leisure snacks; and puffed food. It sells its products under the ChaCha and ChaCheer brands. The company also engages in food research; the purchase and sale of agricultural and sideline products; investment and trade; food production project investment; wholesale and retail of prepackaged food; investment consulting, investment management, and industrial investment; internet and food sales; enterprise management consulting; enterprise management; and technical services.
